subject: CloudPort marketplace onboarding — PO routing & vendor packet questions
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudport.tech>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudPort marketplace onboarding — PO routing & vendor packet questions

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday — glad to see CloudPort moving toward an AWS/GCP marketplace listing. We're starting the procurement intake on our side to ensure our finance and marketplace teams are aligned for a smooth go-live. A few quick asks so we can map the correct PO/contract lane: 

- Do you intend to sell via AWS/GCP/Azure managed marketplace metering (marketplace invoice) or via direct purchase orders (reseller invoice)?
- If marketplace-managed, does CloudPort require a reseller tax form or an EOR to be present in the vendor packet?
- Please share your vendor onboarding packet (vendor/legal + W9/W8/VAT) and a sample PO invoice flow if available.

Goal: I want to confirm whether this will flow through our Marketplace procurement lane (automated ticket -> marketplace billing team -> PO issuance) or through traditional direct PO (platform support + finance manual route). If you can attach the onboarding packet I can loop in our procurement lead (Vanessa) to route appropriately.

Thanks — planning to create a mutual action plan once we confirm the lane.

Best,
Dylan Brooks\Account Executive\Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudport.tech>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@awsmarketplace.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudPort marketplace onboarding — PO routing & vendor packet questions

Hey Dylan — great to connect.

Short answers: we plan to list on AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace initially. We prefer the marketplace-managed purchase flow for the first 12 months to simplify customer billing. I attached our onboarding packet and the tax/reseller guidance we send to marketplace partners. The packet includes: vendor profile, company legal (inc formation docs), US W9, EU VAT certificate, and our reseller agreement stub.

I've CC'd Tom Reed from the AWS Marketplace team in case you need the AWS-specific PO/metering notes.

Attachments:
- CloudPort_vendor_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf (13 KB)
- Marketplace_tax_reseller_form.pdf (9 KB)

Let me know if you need anything else. If the marketplace lane looks ok, we can start with a pilot listing and a trial contract.

Cheers,
Alicia Gomez\Head of Partnerships, CloudPort Inc.
[Attachment: CloudPort_vendor_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudport.tech>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudPort marketplace onboarding — PO routing & vendor packet questions

Thanks for the packet, Alicia. Quick internal note to Dylan: 

- If CloudPort intends to route via AWS/GCP marketplace-managed purchasing, we put this through the Marketplace procurement lane. That means we will not issue a traditional Redwood PO to CloudPort; instead billing is handled by the marketplace and customer purchases are reconciled via metering/invoice. Our marketplace lane requires the vendor packet + marketplace listing confirmation + AWS seller ID for AWS marketplace.
- Required items from CloudPort for our intake: completed vendor packet (received), AWS Seller ID (missing), contact for marketplace billing ops (Tom? ok), and a signed marketplace reseller acknowledgement (we can accept the form you provided).
- If CloudPort needs our finance to issue a vendor PO (direct invoice), that triggers the Direct-PO lane and requires tax W9/W8, company banking details, and a signed Redwood master services agreement — that path takes longer (2–4 weeks).

Alicia — can you send your AWS Seller ID and confirm whether CloudPort wants Redwood to create the marketplace listing metadata or if you'll own listing creation? Our default is to have vendor own listing and Redwood submit required product metadata to marketplace ops.

Kimberly — please advise on the PO template and any billing exceptions we should expect for cross-region (US/EU) listings.

Vanessa Ortiz\Senior Procurement Manager\Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudport.tech>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudPort marketplace onboarding — PO routing & vendor packet questions

Thanks Vanessa — adding a few operational details so Alicia knows what to expect from Redwood's side: 

1) Marketplace lane checklist (estimated turnaround ~5 business days once we have AWS Seller ID + packet):
   - Confirm marketplace channel (AWS/GCP) and seller ID
   - Upload vendor packet to secure drive + generate vendor ID in our procurement system
   - Configure billing mapping: marketplace invoices route to Marketplace Billing team (no Redwood PO generated)
   - Create a short mutual action plan (MAP) listing go-live milestones and acceptance tests

2) Direct-PO lane (if you later need it):
   - We'll require bank wiring details + completed W9/W8 + signed Redwood MSA
   - Finance lead signs off and we issue PO; expected 7–14 business day processing

3) PO template: attached is our internal PO template (PO_template_Redwood_2026.xlsx) for your finance team to preview. Note: for marketplace listings we typically leave the 'PO number' blank and record marketplace invoice reference numbers instead.

4) EU VAT & tax: per the Marketplace_tax_reseller_form.pdf you sent, we'll need proof of VAT registration for EU invoicing. If CloudPort wants Redwood to handle VAT withholding or local invoicing, that will push this into the Direct-PO lane.

Alicia — if you can confirm: (a) AWS Seller ID, (b) who will own listing creation, and (c) billing contact for marketplace ops, we can kick off the intake. I'm attaching the PO template and will create the procurement ticket once we have seller ID.

Best,
Kimberly Park\Procurement Ops Lead\Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_template_Redwood_2026.xlsx]

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudport.tech>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudPort marketplace onboarding — PO routing & vendor packet questions

Kimberly / Vanessa / Dylan — thanks for the clarity.

Answers: 
- AWS Seller ID: AWS-SELLER-98321 (see internal confirmation snippet below).
- CloudPort will own listing creation for both AWS and GCP; we will share the listing metadata JSON once ready.
- Billing contact: finance@cloudport.tech (Julian Park, Billing Ops).

We reviewed the PO template — looks good for preview. We plan to start on marketplace-managed purchases. Please proceed with the Marketplace procurement lane; let me know when you create the procurement ticket and any additional docs you need.
